Name: Standardized Krobus
Author: minervamaga
TagLine: Changes Krobus's sprite to the standard 16x32 size of other NPCs
Description:
DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS MOD FROM ANYWHERE EXCEPT NEXUSMODS, MODDROP, OR MY GITHUB
Other websites are stealing mods from Nexus and uploading them without permission, while earning money on each mod they steal.  My mods are always found on the three sites listed above and no where else.

What started as an unofficial update to [Underdark Krobus](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3071)﻿ turned into a standalone mod.  KirbyLink's version used a Harmony patch that broke completely with the update to SDV 1.4; when Pathos beat me to the update, I decided to turn my update-in-progress into its own mod.  There are two downloads available - one with the vanilla Krobus resized and one with no content pack, to be used with whichever sprites you wish!

Possible future features: add the Dwarf

Install

1.  [Install the latest version of SMAPI](https://smapi.io/).

2.  Download this mod and unzip it.

3.  Copy  the 'Standardized Krobus' folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.

4.  Run the game using SMAPI, you're done!
